result.title: Bayesian Optimization of CVaR with Unknown Hyperparameters
result.summary: We study Bayesian optimization of the Conditional Value-at-Risk (CVaR) of an expensive black-box function that depends on a decision and an environmental variable. Existing no-regret algorithms assume that the correct Gaussian process (GP) kernel and its hyperparameters are known. In practice, however, they must be estimated from limited data, often yielding a misspecified surrogate. This is especially damaging for CVaR because misspecification can distort the estimated tail-risk and thus lead to catastrophic decisions. We propose HE-CV-UCB, the first no-regret algorithm for CVaR Bayesian optimization with unknown GP hyperparameters. Given a finite candidate set containing a well-specified model, HE-CV-UCB adaptively eliminates those inconsistent with the observed data, actively queries where the survivors disagree, and returns a design that is robust across the surviving candidates. We prove that it attains cumulative regret matching the oracle rate of CV-UCB up to a factor depending only on the candidate set's size. Across synthetic benchmarks and three real-world applications, HE-CV-UCB achieves competitive performance and frequently outperforms existing CVaR Bayesian optimization methods.

AI.brief_summary: 研究高斯过程超参数未知时对昂贵黑盒函数的 CVaR 贝叶斯优化，提出 HE-CV-UCB：维护候选模型集、剔除与观测不一致者、在幸存者分歧处主动查询，并返回对残余候选稳健的设计，理论上达到接近 oracle 的累积遗憾。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「淘汰与数据不一致的候选模型、在分歧处主动查询、并在模型不确定性下做稳健决策」的思路，可能与 LVR 中的视觉证据筛选、不确定性驱动的证据获取与停止判断存在概念性联系，可供核查是否可迁移为动态取证的准则。
